projection: orthographic, straight down (rotation-safe: rotate the sprite freely to face any heading)
forward: +Y in world == UP in the sprite image
anchor: image centre == the piece's grid-cell anchor

strip.u_spans: the full tube width, edge to edge
strip.tile: REPEAT vertically — every pattern layer is periodic over the tile, so it tiles without mirroring. Do not mirror it: that flips the scales' overlap direction on alternate tiles, pointing the skin backwards down half the snake.

normal.note: shading normals of the same tube, colour = normal * 0.5 + 0.5 (sRGB-encoded PNG), R across / G along / B up. Not consumed by the game yet — baked for a future dynamically lit ribbon.
